english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Gathering in of the [E]lements
english_classification.chapter_note: A very short chapter with a remarkably clean substrate core. Paragraph 2 is the heart: a systematic degree-based return sequence mapping the gathering-in of the five light elements upward through cosmic intermediaries to the aeons. This is pure correspondential substrate — an ascending chain where each domain gathers into the next. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system. The chapter shows mild editorial fatigue: the brief devotional closure in P3 ('place of rest for ever and ever') is appended after the teaching is complete. The substrate teaching in P2 is notable for its restoration brackets, indicating manuscript damage that has been editorially restored — the Pillar→First Man→Ambassador chain is reconstructed.
